overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole held its fifth preliminary budget meeting for Fiscal Year 2027 to review various municipal department and commission budgets. The committee voted to refer the discussed budget questions and statements of support to the administration and keep the matter in committee.

items.title: Cable and Medford Community Media Budget Review
items.summary: Reviewed the Medford Community Media budget, which includes a proposed full-time production coordinator position funded through a newly proposed special revenue account.

items.title: Health, Animal Control, and Civil Defense Budget Review
items.summary: Reviewed the Health department budget and approved a motion supporting the renaming of the Board of Health to the Health and Human Services Department.

items.title: Planning, Development, Sustainability, and Associated Commissions Budget Review
items.summary: Reviewed the Planning, Development, and Sustainability budget and associated commission budgets, discussing park upgrades, climate grants, and linkage fee calculations.

items.title: Executive, License, and Hormel Commissions Budget Review
items.summary: Reviewed the Executive, License Commission, and Hormel Commission budgets, focusing on personnel funding adjustments and Medford Arts Council funding.

items.title: Law Department Budget Review
items.summary: Debated the Law Department budget, with council members raising concerns over litigation transparency, staff turnover, and suggesting cuts to legal services and the vacant solicitor position.

items.title: Budget Referrals and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved a motion to refer the discussed budget questions and statements of support to the administration and keep the paper in committee.
